crossRefs.note: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since Yahweh has testified…
that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it…
He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be…
From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine…

translations.web: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
translations.bsb: You have bound me, and it has become a witness; my frailty rises up and testifies against me.
translations.kjv: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
translations.asv: And thou hast laid fast hold on me, which is a witness against me: And my leanness riseth up against me, It testifieth to my face.
